newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BASKETBALL STAR GALIS TO TAKE COMPANY PUBLIC.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BASKETBALL STAR GALIS TO TAKE COMPANY PUBLIC.

text.p: Greek basketball legend Nick Galis, owner of a camping and youth centre operation has filed for listing on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market, aiming to tap the capital market for 400 million drachmas.
Nick Galis Youth Centres SA was founded in 1992 and is based in Thessaloniki. It currently operates youth camping sites and sports facilities in 65 hectares in Halkidiki in northern Greece.
"It is a market leader in its sector witnessing steady growth in the membership of its youth camps. In 1996 it hosted 2,500 children from all over Greece," said issue advisor D Finance.
Lead underwriter is ABN AMRO bank.
IPO proceeds will finance a new youth centre which will also provide medical services to people over the age of 50, D Finance said.

Nick Galis Youth Centres SA had sales of 400 million drachmas in 1996, up 46 percent from a year earlier. It expects fiscal 1996 earnings growth of 97 percent as pretax profits are seen around 140 million drachmas.

"Adidas will be sending groups of children from all over Europe to participate in athletic events and this is a major success as it secures a continuous flow of members for the coming years," D Finance said.
Galis is the first all-time scorer in Greek basketball's first division. He led Greece to win its only European championship in 1987. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
